items.title: NADF supports 4,000 flood-affected rice, maize farmers in Ogun
items.summary: The National Agricultural Development Fund (NADF) has disbursed emergency aid to 4,000 small-scale farmers in Ogun State in response to the 2026 rainy season floods that devastated the state. The support aims at revitalising the livelihoods of affected farming communities.
